article: For each question, write the correct answer. The Westway Cinema The new Westway Cinema is finally open! I went last night with my brother, and we both agreed it's much better than the old one (27)…………… it used to be, though the ticket prices are higher, the extra cost is worth paying.  The new owners (28)…………… taken out all the old seats and put in brand new ones that are really comfortable. There's also new air conditioning. This is fantastic because in the past it was sometimes (29)…………… hot that it was difficult to concentrate on the film!  There are also special offers available. For example, (30)…………… you buy two tickets, you can choose something for free – either a snack or a drink. I'm sure this (31)…………… be popular, as you can't bring (32)…………… own food into the cinema.  I'd really recommend going to the Westway Cinema – it's a great night out.

explanations.27:
原因：定语从句修饰 the old one，关系代词作宾语。
语法点：先行词指物，用 which/that，如 The book which/that I read is interesting.
explanations.28:
原因：现在完成时 “have taken out”，强调对现在的影响。
语法点：主语 owners 为复数，用 have + done，如 They have finished the work.
explanations.29:
原因：“so...that...” 结果状语从句，“太热以至于难以集中”。
语法点：so + adj. + that，如 so loud that I can't hear.
explanations.30:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果买两张票”。
语法点：if 引导真实条件句，如 If you study hard, you will pass.
explanations.31:
原因：一般将来时，“这将会很受欢迎”。
语法点：will + 动词原形，表将来，如 He will come tomorrow.
explanations.32:
原因：“your own food”，“你自己的食物”。
词汇点：one's own + 名词，如 my own room（我自己的房间）。
